$comment: Check digit algorithms referenced by the utility specs. Every Brazilian document number in the library is a weighted modulus sum, so the algorithms are described as data rather than reimplemented per utility.

cpf.description: Modulus 11 over the base, weights running from base length + 1 down to 2, repeated cumulatively for each check digit: the second digit is computed over the base plus the first one.

pis.description: Modulus 11 over the 10 base digits with the fixed weight vector 3 2 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2.
